mapper.select: select cm.message_id, cm.conversation_id, cm.sender_id, u1.nickname as sender_name, u1.avatar as sender_avatar, cm.receiver_id, u2.nickname as receiver_name, u2.avatar as receiver_avatar, cm.content, cm.message_type, cm.is_read, cm.create_time from tb_chat_message cm left join tb_user u1 on cm.sender_id = u1.user_id left join tb_user u2 on cm.receiver_id = u2.user_id where cm.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and cm.status = 1 order by cm.create_time asc

select cm.message_id, cm.conversation_id, cm.sender_id, u1.nickname as sender_name, u1.avatar as sender_avatar, cm.receiver_id, u2.nickname as receiver_name, u2.avatar as receiver_avatar, cm.content, cm.message_type, cm.is_read, cm.create_time from tb_chat_message cm left join tb_user u1 on cm.sender_id = u1.user_id left join tb_user u2 on cm.receiver_id = u2.user_id where cm.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and cm.status = 1 and cm.receiver_id = #{userId} and cm.is_read = 0 order by cm.create_time asc
